# Domain events

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/eventcatalog` (backend/) from domain/events. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every state-changing action raises a domain event: written to the outbox in
the same transaction as the change, published to NATS JetStream by the relay
(stream subjects `{domain}.>`). Consumers decide what an event means to them.

## Naming standard

`{domain}.{entity}.{verb}` -- e.g. `procurement.purchase_order.created`

- **domain** -- the bounded context, as in `backend/domain/<domain>` (one of the domains below).
- **entity** -- the aggregate or record acted on, singular snake_case: `purchase_order`, `purchase_order_line_item`.
- **verb** -- what happened, past tense snake_case. An event is a fact, never a command:
  `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, `status_changed`, `item_scanned` -- not `create`, `update_status`.
- All lowercase, exactly three dot-separated parts. Enforced by `domain/events/naming_test.go`.

Domains: `apikeys`, `channels`, `collections`, `coupons`, `customers`, `fx`, `iam`, `integrations`, `inventory`, `messagecenter`, `newsletter`, `notifications`, `oms`, `payments`, `pms`, `procurement`, `promotions`, `reviews`, `scheduler`, `settings`, `shipping`, `storefront`, `suppliers`, `tax`, `theme`, `webhook_forwarding`, `whatsapp`.

## Standard action event

Raised with one call inside the use case's `tenant.WithTenant` transaction:

```go
// 1. register the action once, in domain/events/actions_<domain>.go
SupplierUpdated = defineAction("suppliers.supplier.updated", "A supplier's details were changed.")

// 2. record it in the use case, atomic with the write
return eventrecord.Record(ctx, uc.outbox, events.SupplierUpdated, s.ID,
	eventrecord.NewChanges().Set("name", old.Name, s.Name).Set("lead_time_days", old.LeadTimeDays, s.LeadTimeDays))
```

Payload (`events.EntityAction`):

```json
{
  "event": "suppliers.supplier.updated",
  "event_id": "0b8a…",                       // dedupe key for consumers
  "occurred_at": "2026-10-06T12:00:00Z",
  "tenant_id": "…",
  "actor": { "type": "user", "user_id": "…", "role": "customer_admin" },  // or { "type": "system" }
  "entity_id": "…",
  "changes": { "lead_time_days": { "before": 14, "after": 21 } },          // updates: changed fields only
  "data": { … }                              // action-specific facts, see each event's description
}
```

`changes` and `data` are omitted when empty. Consumers needing the full record read it by `entity_id`.

## Catalog

210 events. **action** = standard `EntityAction` envelope above; **typed** = its own payload (fields listed).

### apikeys

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apikeys.api_key.created` | action | An API key was created (e.g. for the WooCommerce plugin). data: name, sales_channel_id. | envelope |
| `apikeys.api_key.revoked` | action | An API key was revoked and stops working. | envelope |

### channels

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `channels.category.imported` | action | A category was created from an external shop's category while importing its products. data: provider, external_id, name, slug, parent_id. | envelope |
| `channels.customer.imported` | action | A customer was created from an external shop's customer. data: provider, external_customer_id, email, source (customer_import, order_import). | envelope |
| `channels.external_category_link.deleted` | action | A category mapping to an external shop was removed. | envelope |
| `channels.external_category_link.saved` | action | A CommerceOS category was linked to a category in an external shop (a person mapped it, or it was matched by slug on push). data: connection_id, provider, external_id, category_id, source (manual, slug_match). | envelope |
| `channels.external_product.deleted` | action | A deleted product was also deleted from an external shop (entity_id is the external id). data: provider, connection_id. | envelope |
| `channels.import_job.created` | action | A product import from an external shop was queued. data: connection_id, default_warehouse_id, default_currency, is_first_import. | envelope |
| `channels.imported_category.deleted` | action | A category left empty after clearing a connection's imported products was deleted. data: connection_id. | envelope |
| `channels.imported_product.deleted` | action | A product imported from a connection was deleted when that connection's imported data was cleared. data: connection_id, external_id. | envelope |
| `channels.order.imported` | action | A sales order was created from an external channel's order. data: provider, connection_id, external_order_id, number, status, currency_code, total_minor_units, line_count, unlinked_line_count, needs_sku_review. | envelope |
| `channels.order.status_pushed` | action | A sales order's status was sent to the channel it came from. data: provider, connection_id, external_order_id, status, channel_status. | envelope |
| `channels.order.stock_shortage_detected` | action | An imported order's stock could not be taken for some lines (marked pending, order flagged for stock review). data: pending_line_item_ids. | envelope |
| `channels.product.imported` | action | A product was created from an external shop's product (its listing also raises product_listing.created, source import). data: connection_id, provider, external_id, variant_id, sku_id, sku_code, category_id, price_minor_units, currency_code. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.created` | action | A product or variant was linked to a listing on an external channel. data: product_id, variant_id, connection_id, provider, external_id, is_variation, source (push, variant_added, link_existing, import). | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.deleted` | action | A listing was removed. data: product_id, variant_id, connection_id, provider, external_id, reason (shape_migration, variant_removed). | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.gated` | action | A listing was taken off sale on its channel because the product is no longer active (Woo status pushed, Bol offer put on hold). data: product_id, connection_id, provider, external_id. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.synced` | action | A listing was synced with its channel (a sync log entry was written; an unchanged successful re-sync records nothing). changes: the synced fields that changed since the previous sync, before/after as strings. data: product_id, connection_id, provider, external_id, direction (push, import), status (success, error), error_message. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.ungated` | action | A gated listing went back on sale after the product became active again. data: product_id, connection_id, provider, external_id. | envelope |
| `channels.product_listing.updated` | action | A listing's link changed (changes: variant_id, external_id, not_for_sale_note). data: product_id, connection_id, provider. | envelope |
| `channels.sale_price.backfilled` | action | A SKU's missing sale price was filled in from its external shop listing (entity_id is the SKU). changes: sale_price_minor_units, sale_end_date. data: connection_id, external_id. | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel.created` | action | A sales channel (web shop, Bol, POS...) was set up. data: name, type, connection_id, enrollment_mode, currency_code. | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel.deleted` | action | A sales channel was deleted. data: name, type. | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel.updated` | action | A sales channel's settings changed (changes: name, connection_id, enrollment_mode, enrollment_category_id, enrollment_tag, price_adjustment_basis_points, quantity_breaks, default_warehouse_id, storefront_mode, sign_in_url, storefront_locale, storefront_locales, active, payment_connection_id). | envelope |
| `channels.sales_channel_product_override.set` | action | A product was explicitly included in or excluded from a sales channel, overriding its enrollment rule. data: channel_id, product_id, included. | envelope |
| `channels.sync_log_entry.dismissed` | action | A failed channel sync was dismissed from the sync log (no data). | envelope |
| `channels.sync_schedule.saved` | action | An automatic sync schedule for a connection was created or changed. data: connection_id, entity_type, direction, enabled, interval_minutes, default_warehouse_id, default_currency. | envelope |
| `channels.tax_class.imported` | action | A tax class was created for an external shop's tax class. data: provider, external_slug, name. | envelope |
| `channels.tax_rate.imported` | action | A tax rate was created or updated from an external shop's tax rates. data: provider, tax_class_id, country, rate_basis_points. | envelope |

| `procurement.booking_scan.deleted` | action | A booking scan was undone. data: booking_id, sku_id, action_type. | envelope |
| `procurement.goods.received` | typed | GoodsReceived is raised when a purchase-order line item's stock is actually received into inventory -- a real inventory.Batch created with a landed cost basis (application/inventory.ReceiveStockUseCase), not merely a PO being created or edited (see procurement.PurchaseOrder's own design: "don't change inventory cost merely because a PO was created"). | `GoodsReceived`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sku_id, warehouse_id, batch_id, purchase_order_line_item_id, quantity, landed_unit_cost_minor_units |
| `procurement.purchase_order.created` | action | A purchase order was created. data.source: manual, document or purchase_planner. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order.deleted` | action | A purchase order was deleted with its line items. data: supplier_id, status. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order.updated` | action | A purchase order changed (changes: supplier_id, warehouse_id, status, currency_code, expected_date, notes). data.reason is set when the system changed it: line_items_resolved (needs_review -> draft once every product line is linked). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.attached` | action | A supplier document (invoice / order confirmation file) was attached to a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id, file_name, content_type, parsing_job_id, duplicate_of_purchase_order_id (set when the same file is already on another PO; its lines are then copied instead of parsed). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.deleted` | action | A supplier document was removed from a purchase order (its file deleted from storage). data: purchase_order_id, file_name. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.parsed` | action | A supplier document was read into purchase order lines (each line also raises purchase_order_line_item.added, source document). data: purchase_order_id, parsing_job_id, line_count, unmatched_count, suggested_supplier_name, suggested_currency_code. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_document.parsing_retried` | action | Parsing of a supplier document was requested again. data: purchase_order_id, parsing_job_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.added` | action | A line was added to a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id, sku_id, quantity, units_per_purchased_item, unit_cost_minor_units, line_type, source -- manual, or duplicate_document (copied from the PO an identical document was already attached to). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.linked` | action | A purchase order line was linked to a catalog SKU (changes: sku_id, units_per_purchased_item). data: purchase_order_id, source -- manual (a person picked the SKU) or supplier_alias (matched from the supplier's learned aliases). | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.removed` | action | A line was removed from a purchase order. data: purchase_order_id, sku_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.purchase_order_line_item.updated` | action | A purchase order line changed (changes: sku_id, raw_sku, raw_description, quantity, units_per_purchased_item, unit_cost_minor_units, line_type). data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_discrepancy.acknowledged` | action | Someone reviewed an invoice discrepancy and accepted it. data: receiving_record_id, type. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_discrepancy.detected` | action | An invoice or delivery differs from its purchase order. data: receiving_record_id, type (missing_item, quantity_mismatch, unexpected_item, expiry_mismatch, damaged_item), line_item_id, expected_qty, received_qty, source -- invoice (found by comparing the invoice) or manual (flagged by a person, e.g. damaged). | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_discrepancy.linked` | action | An unexpected invoice line and a missing purchase order line were matched as the same item (both become acknowledged; one event each). data: receiving_record_id, type, linked_discrepancy_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_record.completed` | action | Review of an uploaded invoice was finished. data: purchase_order_id. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_record.created` | action | A supplier invoice was uploaded against a purchase order to check what was delivered. data: purchase_order_id, file_name, content_type, parsing_job_id, potential_duplicate. | envelope |
| `procurement.receiving_record.parsed` | action | An uploaded invoice was compared with its purchase order (each difference also raises receiving_discrepancy.detected). data: purchase_order_id, parsing_job_id, discrepancy_count. | envelope |

### promotions

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |

| `promotions.promotion.created` | action | A promotion was created. data: name, type, status, starts_at, ends_at, lines. | envelope |
| `promotions.promotion.deleted` | action | A promotion was deleted (applied prices were reverted first, each raising promotion_line.reverted). data: name. | envelope |
| `promotions.promotion.updated` | action | A promotion changed (changes: name, type, status, starts_at, ends_at, lines). data.reason clearance_finished when the system ended it because its last clearance line finished. | envelope |
| `promotions.promotion_line.applied` | action | A promotion line put its SKU on sale. data: promotion_id, sku_id, sale_price_minor_units, previous_sale_price_minor_units. | envelope |
| `promotions.promotion_line.finished` | action | A clearance line ended because its batch sold out, expired or was removed. data: promotion_id, sku_id, batch_id. | envelope |
| `promotions.promotion_line.reverted` | action | A promotion line's SKU went back to its pre-promotion sale price. data: promotion_id, sku_id, restored_sale_price_minor_units. | envelope |

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |

### shipping

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shipping.carrier_override.updated` | action | A carrier's per-connection option overrides were set. entity_id is the connection id. data: carrier. changes: package_type, signature_required, only_recipient, insure_by_default, tracking_url_template. | envelope |
| `shipping.connection_settings.updated` | action | A shipping connection's defaults changed. entity_id is the connection id. changes: default_carrier, default_package_type, default_label_format, default_label_size, default_signature_required, default_only_recipient, insure_by_default, myparcel_account_id, myparcel_shop_id, auto_print_enabled, export_order_to_myparcel. | envelope |
| `shipping.fulfilment_order.exported` | action | A sales order was exported to MyParcel as a fulfilment order. data: sales_order_id, connection_id, myparcel_uuid, status. | envelope |
| `shipping.shipment.cancelled` | action | A shipment was cancelled in CommerceOS so a corrected one can be made. data: sales_order_id, deleted_on_carrier (false when the carrier refused, so its label may still exist), note. | envelope |
| `shipping.shipment.created` | action | A shipping label was created with the carrier (MyParcel). data: sales_order_id, connection_id, carrier, external_shipment_id, barcode, package_type, insured. | envelope |
| `shipping.shipment.fulfillment_signal` | typed | ShipmentFulfillmentSignal is raised whenever inbound MyParcel activity implies a SalesOrder might need to advance -- both its Shipments API (shipment_status_change webhook, and ReconcileShipmentsUseCase's poll of the same API) and its separate Orders/Fulfilment API (order_status_change webhook's "processed" status) raise this same event instead of each deciding inline what it means for the order (see application/shipping.ApplyShipmentFulfillmentSignalUseCase, the one place that decision is made, consumed via infrastructure/consumers.ShipmentFulfillmentSignalConsumer). | `ShipmentFulfillmentSignal`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sales_order_id, kind, status_main, status_code |
| `shipping.webhook_event.redispatched` | action | Someone retried dispatching a stored carrier/channel webhook. data: provider, topic, status (processed or failed), error. What the webhook itself changed raises its own events. | envelope |

### storefront

| Subject | Kind | Description | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storefront.cart.coupon_applied` | action | A coupon was applied to a cart. data: coupon_code, discount_minor_units. changes: coupon_code. | envelope |
| `storefront.cart.coupon_removed` | action | A cart's coupon was removed. changes: coupon_code. | envelope |
| `storefront.cart.created` | action | A shopper started a cart. data: sales_channel_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.cart.items_updated` | action | A cart's lines were replaced (add, remove or change quantity). data: sales_channel_id, line_count, items (sku_id, sku_code, quantity). changes: items (before/after, sku_code -> quantity). | envelope |
| `storefront.customer_session.ended` | action | A shopper signed out. data: sales_channel_id, customer_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.customer_session.started` | action | A shopper signed in with a magic link (the link is now used). data: sales_channel_id, customer_id, magic_link_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.magic_link.requested` | action | A shopper asked for a sign-in link; it was emailed. data: sales_channel_id, customer_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.order.placed` | typed | StorefrontOrderPlaced is raised once by CheckoutCartUseCase, right after the oms.SalesOrder it creates commits -- the first "an order was created" event this codebase has ever raised (SalesOrderStatusChanged fires only on a later status transition, never on creation). | `StorefrontOrderPlaced`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, sales_order_id |
| `storefront.payment_link.created` | action | A checkout payment link was created at the channel's payment provider (entity_id: the provider's link id). data: sales_channel_id, provider, reference (order number), amount_minor_units, currency_code. | envelope |
| `storefront.review.submitted` | action | A shopper submitted a product review (awaiting moderation). data: sales_channel_id, product_id, rating, verified (bought the product). | envelope |
| `storefront.theme.created` | typed |  | `ThemeCreated`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, theme_id, sales_channel_id |
| `storefront.theme.deleted` | typed |  | `ThemeDeleted`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, theme_id, sales_channel_id |
| `storefront.theme.draft_started` | action | Editing a published theme started a new draft version (a copy of the live one). data: version_id, version_number, based_on_version_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme.published` | typed | ThemePublished fires when a draft is sealed and goes live -- the signal for anything caching the channel's live storefront to refresh. | `ThemePublished`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, theme_id, sales_channel_id, version_id, version_number |
| `storefront.theme.renamed` | action | A theme was renamed. changes: name. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme.rolled_back` | typed |  | `ThemeRolledBack`: event_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, theme_id, sales_channel_id, version_id, version_number |
| `storefront.theme.settings_updated` | action | A theme draft's global settings (colors, fonts, logo...) were saved. data: version_id, revision. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_asset.deleted` | action | A theme asset was removed from the library. data: filename. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_asset.updated` | action | A theme asset's details changed. changes: alt. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_asset.uploaded` | action | An image was added to the tenant's theme asset library. data: filename, content_type, bytes, width, height. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_document.updated` | action | A theme draft document (page, header, footer...) was saved. data: theme_id, version_id, kind, key, revision. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_page.created` | action | A page was added to a theme draft. data: theme_id, version_id, key, title, revision. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_page.deleted` | action | A page was removed from a theme draft. data: theme_id, version_id, key, revision. | envelope |
| `storefront.theme_session.created` | action | An editor or preview session was opened for a theme. data: theme_id, purpose, user_id, role, locale. | envelope |
| `storefront.wishlist.created` | action | A shopper started a wishlist. data: sales_channel_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.wishlist.item_added` | action | A product was added to a wishlist. data: sales_channel_id, product_id. | envelope |
| `storefront.wishlist.item_removed` | action | A product was removed from a wishlist. data: sales_channel_id, product_id. | envelope |
